sentences.text:
Sl. Nos.60  ss IN THE HIGH COURT AT CALCUTTA  CONSTITUTIONAL WRIT JURISDICTION  (Appellate Side)
 W.P.A. 22572 of 2014
Calcutta
Electric

Manufacturing Co. Ltd. & anr.
 Vs.
State of West Bengal & ors.

Mr. Arobinda Chatterjee, Sr. Adv.
 Mr. A. K. Gayen  Ms. A. A. Gayen  ... for the petitioners  Mr. K. N. Nabi  Mr. Amritalal Chatterjee  ... for the State  Mr. Satyajit Talukdar  .. for the K. M. D. A.
 Mr. K. N. Nabi, learned Advocate for the State-  respondents files report by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust, Howrah.
Copy served.
Such report is taken on record.

Mr. Partha Pratim Sadhukhan, Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust,
Howrah in compliance with the previous order is present in person.
His personal appearance is dispensed with until further orders.

Mr. K. N. Nabi, learned Advocate for the State- respondents referring to the communication annexed to the report submits that the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust, Howrah, has already made communication to the Special Secretary, Estate Unit (L.A.),
K.M.D.A. for allotting the desired fund of Rs.6,41,17,119/- for disbursing the amount in favour of the petitioners.

Mr. Arobinda Chatterjee, learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the petitioners referring to page 8 of the supplementary affidavit submits that as per the New Act of 2013 estimate of Calcutta Electric Manufacturing Co. ... vs State Of West Bengal & Ors on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128610395/
1 Rs.6,89,97,607/- and estimate of Rs.2,74,353/- were already made by the Howrah Improvement Trust and both the estimates were sent to the Land and Land Reforms Department vide its office memo No.231/LA(IT) dated 1st July, 2015 for finalisation of the compensation and therefore, the Court on 12th October, 2023 after considering the entire facts sought for report for finalisation of such compensation by the Land and Land Reforms Department pursuant to letter dated 1st July,
2015.
He submits that the report submitted today by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust, Howrah is silent about such estimate.
Mr. K. N. Nabi, learned Advocate for the State- respondents also fails to apprise the Court regarding finalisation of the compensation in terms of letter dated 1st July, 2015.
He seeks accommodation to inform the Court regarding finalisation of such estimates of compensation by Land and Land Reforms Department.

Upon perusal of the report submitted by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Howrah Improvement Trust, Howrah, it is found that the letter addressed to the Special Secretary, Estate Unit, (L.A.),
K.M.D.A. dated 11th December, 2023 is silent about previous estimates that were forwarded to the Land and Land Reforms Department vide its office memo dated 1st July, 2015.

Further, the letter issued by the department of Land & Land Reforms and Refugee Relief & Rehabilitation Department on 5th December, 2023 also does not disclose of the previous estimates that were sent for finalisation to the Land and Land Reforms Department by the Howrah Improvement Trust on 1st July, 2015.

In view of the above, the respondent nos.1 and 3 as also respondent no.9 being Special Land Acquisition Officer, shall submit report with regard to the status of the two estimates that were sent for finalisation vide letter dated 1st July, 2015 annexing Memo no.231/LA(IT) dated 1st July, 2015 within two weeks after reopening after winter vacation.
Let the matter appear on 16th January, 2024.
All concerned parties shall act in terms of the copy of the order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.

< (Bivas Pattanayak, J.)
